purpose: Separate scope after predict-v3: the same causal expanding-mean pipeline at a 20-session horizon, scored on fixed non-overlapping blocks against an always-zero baseline. Forecast study only; addresses the owner's mid-term question only as a prediction-score diagnostic, never as a profitability judgement.

parents.adjusted_prices: 844b27891727b1faa227ea3259cb47eee258f8bf85ec30a3fc6a41b5a299a609 (adjusted C for the optional MA200 regime only)

target.definition: Y_j = O[j+21]/O[j+1] - 1: raw open of session j+1 to raw open of session j+21, gross simple price return over 20 held sessions

timing.decision: close i, information through close i (raw and adjusted through i)
timing.maturity: training pairs j >= 199 and j + 21 <= i (j <= i - 21); labels for j in (i-21, i-1] are immature and excluded
timing.update_order: at close i incorporate the newly matured label j = i - 21 (its exit open O[i] is observed at open i), assigned to the regime observed at its own decision j if a regime variant is included; then emit the prediction for entry i+1
timing.feedback: mature labels update expanding statistics by the fixed rule; scores, diagnostics and immature labels never update predictors

fixed_block_grid.origin: decision index 3031 = 2014-12-30 (first decision whose entry 2015-01-02 is on or after 2015-01-01), identical to the first decision of the 1-session rungs
fixed_block_grid.stored_predictions: only grid decisions i = origin + 20k with i + 1 < N; predictions on non-grid sessions are neither stored nor scored
fixed_block_grid.scoring: non-overlapping by construction: block k covers entry i_k+1 through exit i_k+21 = i_(k+1)+1, so consecutive blocks share only the boundary open

training_overlap.drafted: B: training uses ALL mature labels j >= 199, j <= i-21 regardless of the grid (overlapping 20-session windows). Reason: each label is an observed fact available at the decision; overlap affects dependence and inference (not computed here), not the validity of the expanding point estimate; it gives about 20x the samples of grid-only training
training_overlap.alternative_for_bill: A: grid-aligned training only (j on the same 20-session grid), non-overlapping but about 1/20 of the samples; one policy must be fixed before the run
training_overlap.both_ends: start: the first grid decision has a pool of mature labels j in [199, origin-21]; end: grid decisions whose exit would fall after the cutoff are stored as pending_outcome (predict, never score or impute); decisions after N-2 do not exist

variants.H1_expanding_mean: mean of mature 20-session labels in the pool; 0 if empty (counted)
variants.H2_ma200_conditional_mean_optional: bill decides; same regime definition as predict-v1 (adjusted C[i] > MA200, equality 0), conditional on the regime at the label's own decision j; fallback to H1 then 0, counted; included only if bill wants exactly one conditional element in this rung

metrics.primary: MSE of each variant on the scored blocks and paired squared-error difference H1-H0 (and H2-H0, H2-H1 if H2 included), overall and by entry year
secondary: uncentered cross moment mean(mu*Y) and centered covariance
sign accuracy where mu != 0 and Y != 0 with eligible/zero counts
blocks per entry year, mature/pending/fallback counts
prohibited_comparisons: comparing 20-session MSE magnitudes with 1-session MSE magnitudes (different target variance and horizon)
judging mid-term profitability from prediction scores
metrics.scale_caution: about 12 blocks per entry year; yearly figures are descriptive only

verification_required: synthetic fixture with pool start 1 and horizon 3 proving maturity j + H + 1 <= i, grid-stored decisions only, exact expanding means, pending at the end, empty pool at the start
perturbation: raw O after k leaves grid decisions <= k unchanged; O[k] may change decision k through the label j = k-21 matured at open k; adjusted C perturbations affect only the optional regime
constant-price full payload: null ratios, zero targets, pending excluded
real data: hashes (raw, adjusted, spec) before and after; calendar facts equal to the computed table above; counts; no real-data estimation in selftest
single xb write with allow_nan=False; separate run log; bill reviews the final code hash before one bounded run

outputs.envelope: contract v3; ordered parents (raw, adjusted, spec)

resources.statistical_learning: expanding means are estimators; report mature-label updates and per-variant estimates (grid-stored vs warm-up)

prohibited_in_this_run: choosing horizon, grid origin, overlap policy or variants after outcomes
open_choices_for_bill: include H2 MA200 conditional or stop at H0/H1
grid origin = first evaluation decision (drafted) vs a calendar anchor
whether to also store (not score) non-grid predictions for later block-offset sensitivity (dobby suggests no: it invites selection)
